execution.limitations: Two sources/one high-noise condition on CPU. Does not reproduce BF16 CUDA monitor or establish broad regression/cause. No output calibration or model change. Unclipped camera RGB mean errors are spatial residuals, not statistical estimator bias.

visual_review.fabric: Both10000 outputs are darker/more yellow than their matched3000 output and exact target. Fine cords remain absent. Camera-space channel means confirm a large scene-dependent shift on this case.
visual_review.building: Outputs remain close and channel-mean residuals are small; no comparable shift is seen on this second example.

decision.next: Complete full427/numerical/native/analytic/GFX review; prioritize color fidelity before selecting another experiment.
